headline: German President Calls for Business Investment at Accra Africa Economic Forum
summary: German President Frank-Walter Steinmeier opened an economic forum in Accra alongside Ghanaian President John Mahama. Steinmeier urged European companies to expand business investments in African markets to drive job creation.
why: Germany is Europe's largest economy seeking to broaden trade ties across West Africa.

impacts.name: Ghana
impacts.why: German leaders urged increased corporate investment in Ghana and across Africa.
